findings.summary: "summarizes the seed data" calls summarizeTasks without passing now, so it uses the real current time; its fixed expected counts hold only on 2026-11-12 and the test fails from the next day on.
"counts a new task that is due today" builds today's date in UTC with toISOString, but the count uses Japan time, so the test fails between 0:00 and 9:00 JST.
No test checks overdue: the seed data has no overdue unfinished task, so the expected value stays 0.
No test checks that completed tasks are left out of the due counts; removing status != 'done' would not make any test fail.
No test covers the dueSoon range boundaries (from tomorrow to soonDays days later, soonDays of 1 and 90, a range crossing a month).
No test covers the JST date change at the boundary (14:59:59Z versus 15:00:00Z).
The 300 ms speed test is flaky because it also times DB migration and seeding and fails under load; it checks nothing about correctness, so it should be removed.
The parseSoonDays tests do not check the accept/reject boundaries ("1", "90", "91", "1.5", "-1", "", "07").
The API route's 401, 400 and 200 responses have no tests.
